text: Chapter 13: The Water Tribe and Coenubia@Water Dome
■Next Mission\nMove from Puerta Islands: Adit to\nSubma Cave to start.
Show Zapo your ability to get permission to pass through\nthe passage to the town of Ranas. Proceed to Espuma Dome\nthrough the tunnel while dealing with monsters!
You entered Espuma Dome and saw the Knight of Thorns.\nIt seems that the Red Ash Dragon Rudis is waiting for you\nahead. Fight together and proceed further!
It seems like the underlings of the Red Ash Dragon Rudis\nhave made their way in. Get rid of them and hurry to the\ndome serving as the entrance to Aquacity!
The Red Ash Dragon Rudis forcefully entered the dome.\nHe is determined to get the royal dragon cocoon even if\nhe has to destroy the town. Defeat him to protect the town!
